lead.headline: ZetaChain Votes to Abandon Its Own Layer 1, Migrate ZETA to Solana
lead.tldr: The infrastructure trade of building standalone chains is facing a brutal repricing as ZetaChain opts for tokenization on Solana rather than continued independence, while stablecoin payments infrastructure attracts serious capital and state-level AI coordination accelerates.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
top_signals.summary: ZetaChain has initiated a vote to shut down its own Layer 1 network and migrate the ZETA token to the Solana blockchain. This represents a major strategic pivot from operating an independent chain to becoming a tokenized asset on an existing high-performance network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: This is the most direct admission yet that the cost of sovereignty—validator sets, security budgets, user acquisition—exceeds the value of independence for mid-tier L1s, and the market is repricing 'chain' equity down to 'token' equity.

top_signals.title: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto
top_signals.summary: North Korean-linked threat actor WaterPlum used fake job recruitment schemes to infect 30,000 devices across 100 countries. The operation resulted in the compromise of over 7,000 crypto wallets and the theft of $10.7 million in digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $10.7M figure is almost certainly understated given victim underreporting, and this operational tempo from WaterPlum suggests North Korean groups have industrialized the talent-poaching vector to the point where it should be underwritten as a persistent cost of doing business in crypto.

top_signals.title: Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25M round with SBI backing
top_signals.summary: Singapore-based stablecoin payments firm Dtcpay has successfully closed a $25 million Series A funding round. The investment, backed by SBI, will be used to expand the company's merchant network and enhance its payment product offerings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SBI's participation in a stablecoin payments Series A at $25M signals that Japanese financial conglomerates are now pricing merchant-network scale in ASEAN above pure protocol-level exposure, shifting capital toward revenue-generating infrastructure.

top_signals.title: Trump says US will form ‘AI Force’ and appoint AI czar: Reports28m, Trump says US will form ‘AI Force’ and appoint AI czar: ReportsTrump posted on Truth Social that his new project would manage the fast-growing sector without adding regulations that could slow innovation.
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump has announced plans to establish an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI czar to manage the artificial intelligence sector. The initiative aims to oversee the industry's growth while avoiding regulations that could hinder innovation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The 'AI Force' framing without regulatory expansion implies the administration will attempt to coordinate compute and data access through procurement and federal placement rather than rulemaking, which creates a parallel playbook for how crypto might be managed.

top_signals.title: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF files for 3-for-1 forward share split44m
top_signals.summary: Grayscale has filed for a 3-for-1 forward share split for its Zcash trust. This move is intended to make the shares more accessible to a broader range of investors by lowering the price per share.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Grayscale's share split mechanics for Zcash are a demand-side bet that retail accessibility matters more than institutional accumulation at this point in the privacy-asset cycle, and the filing itself keeps ZEC in the ETF conversation.

on_the_radar.title: ‘Know your agent’: Banks face a new compliance challenge as AI agents shop and pay on their own
on_the_radar.summary: Banks and card networks are grappling with new compliance challenges as AI agents begin to autonomously handle shopping and payments. This shift necessitates a 'Know Your Agent' framework to verify the identity and authorization of non-human spenders.

on_the_radar.title: The Clarity Act Is Kaput, But Crypto Will Be Fine
on_the_radar.summary: The article discusses the failure of the Clarity Act but suggests that the crypto industry will remain resilient. The focus is now shifting toward agency-level regulatory work which may provide positive opportunities for the sector.

on_the_radar.summary: Dragonfly's Qureshi has advocated for the termination of the Zcash developer fund following the year 2028. The proposal suggests a shift in how the protocol's development is funded over the long term.

on_the_radar.title: Cardano’s IOG warns users to avoid YouTube channel amid apparent hijack46m
on_the_radar.summary: Input Output Global (IOG) has issued a warning to Cardano users regarding a hijacked YouTube channel. The channel is being used to spread fraudulent information and potentially scam users.

on_the_radar.title: NEWS: Blockworks introduces Agentic Detection
on_the_radar.summary: Blockworks has launched Agentic Detection, a tool designed to identify AI-generated content. This initiative aims to maintain transparency and authenticity in news reporting as AI agents become more prevalent.

on_the_radar.title: Sydney Sweeney doesn’t just star in controversial ads. She helps engineer them.
on_the_radar.summary: Actress Sydney Sweeney has taken on a strategic role as an equity partner and creative director at Novig, a sports prediction market. She is actively involved in engineering the platform's advertising campaigns.

on_the_radar.title: AI Labs’ Call to 'Pace Frontier’ Give Crypto Vets FTX Flashbacks
on_the_radar.summary: The article draws a parallel between current AI labs calling for top-down regulation to prevent existential risks and the behavior of FTX prior to its collapse. It suggests that calls for collective coordination by powerful industry players can be a facade for consolidating power.

worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's post-mortem on the CLARITY Act's failure offers a framework for how institutional capital should re-underwrite legislative timelines and what surviving regulatory paths actually look like.

linkedin_post:
ZetaChain is voting to kill its own Layer 1. Not pause. Not pivot to L2. Full shutdown, token migrated to Solana.

This is not a failure of execution. The team shipped. The chain ran. What failed was the economic model underneath independence itself—validator economics, security spend, the whole sovereign-infrastructure premium that L1 tokens commanded from 2021-2023. That premium is now being repriced to zero for anyone outside the top three execution environments.

We're watching the same capital that funded "build your own chain" in 2022 rotate into dtcpay's $25M Series A with SBI. Merchant networks. Stablecoin settlement. Revenue today, not token velocity tomorrow. The underwriting criteria have shifted hard.

What would reverse this? A credible path to self-sustaining validator economics without subsidized emissions. I have not seen one for a new entrant.

The ZETA token may survive. The Layer 1 as an investable thesis, for most, will not.
